defects.where: poster-preview.png, lower lantern strings around x 550-1350, y 950-1250 (overview centre, just above the skyline)
defects.what: Lanterns on the third and fourth strings overlap one another, and cords run behind neighbouring lanterns, so the cluster reads as tangled rather than strung

defects.where: poster-print.pdf page-1 overview, subtitle 'A winter night market on the water'
defects.what: Subtitle sits tight under the title descender and directly on top of the first lantern string, so it is crowded by the glow
The heavily blurred reflection band takes about a quarter of the poster as soft out-of-focus blobs. It is intentional, but it reads close to a smear
Jost's en dash is drawn so long that '4–10' reads like an em dash at size

OJPW.craft_notes: Atmospheric and well judged. The Cormorant italic title with a soft glow, the letterspaced Jost kicker and the italic credit line pair well. The warm lantern haze against the dark blue-black sky is moody, and the blurred lantern reflections convincingly answer 'with their reflections'. The two-column highlight list between hairline rules is tidy, and the 300 dpi CMYK background stays sharp at real size. It is held back by the overlapping lantern strings and a subtitle squeezed against the lanterns.
OJPW.revision_notes: Kicker changed to 'OLD CUSTOMS HOUSE SQUARE' (still caps by styling, as in r1). 'Live brass band' became 'Fire dancers at 8 pm'. A white 1 in square with a centred 'QR' sits exactly at the bottom-right corner of the safe area (measured 100 px at 100 dpi, ending 0.25 in inside the trim). Collateral change: the whole lower info block (date, rules, list, footer and credit) moved up about 0.65 in, so the date now sits on the reflection band. The artwork is otherwise unchanged.

WLRN.craft_notes: Clean, legible and well ordered. The Fraunces bold title and date with the Atkinson Hyperlegible body pair sensibly, and the gold, cream and navy palette is restrained. Vector lanterns are crisp at 300 dpi with soft glows. Overall it is flat and generic: the lanterns, a rectangle skyline and abstract dash reflections don't add up to a scene with depth. The layout is a stack of centred elements with some dead space at the bottom.
WLRN.revision_notes: Kicker changed to 'OLD CUSTOMS HOUSE SQUARE' (caps, as in r1). 'Live brass band' became 'Fire dancers at 8 pm'. A white 1 in square with a centred 'QR' sits exactly at the bottom-right corner of the safe area (measured 100 px at 100 dpi, ending 0.25 in inside the trim; 150 px in the preview). A pixel diff of r1 against r2 shows changes only in the kicker line, the last list item and the QR square. Nothing else moved.

pairwise_round1.why: OJPW's glowing lantern canopy with real blurred reflections and its refined serif-italic and sans typography make a festive, specific scene, where WLRN is clean but flat, with generic dash reflections and a placeholder skyline.
